chapter: Buddy Petit and brass band reading
title: Buddy Petit's playing and his unreliability
summary: Ridgley and Allen discuss Buddy Petit as a versatile cornetist who drank, would oversleep and miss jobs.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: What about Arnold Matoya? Did you ever use him? Well, he helped played with me. But he didn't like the idea of being with us much, you know. We didn't get too much about him. He was a real good corner player. Couldn't I use him? What did Buddy Petit play like? That always fascinates me. Oh, he was good.

That guy could play like anything. He was a real good corner player. He was a real good corner player. He was a real good corner player. Couldn't I use him? That always fascinates me.
Oh, he was good. That guy could play like anything.

He drank hard to get along with that time, you know. When he was sober, it was all right. But if he felt like drinking and didn't get what kind of job you have, he'd just go on to sleep and wouldn't send nobody. I remember once we had to go to Kenwood to play, and I don't know what's going to do. I don't know what's going to do. I don't know what's going to do. I remember once we had to go to Kenwood to play, and I live uptown, and we'd go down way down around Esplanade Street, and Jeremy and his women would get him to go out. We had a big job, you know. We'd go out for a week. A man would go to sleep on you and forget something like that to get you in trouble. But I had such a good grip among the people. Everywhere I went, Louisiana, Mississippi, most of my childhood never did have any trouble.
Must have been an awfully good going up for everyone. Buddy? Does anybody sound anything like Buddy?
Well, see, I don't pay much attention to things like that now, but Buddy was just named Buddy. He said more than Oliver Lewis.
You wouldn't remember what Buddy sounded like if you heard it? I'm going to see if I can find something more. Maybe he's...
I just wondered maybe this particular record sounds a little like Buddy. There's so many fellas tried to imitate his style too, you know.
